subject: GF autonomous queue live + cross-exam dedup guardrail
body:
GF autonomous queue scheme is now live to prevent idle cycles.

What I implemented:
1) SQL evergreen queue with 10 persistent tasks and dependency links
2) WIP rule: 1 in-progress + 5+ pending always
3) New guardrail test: tests/f-validation/exam-cross-exam-dedup.test.js
   - checks practice-6/7 vs prior exams for same type+standard+numeric-answer duplicates
   - advisory mode by default, strict fail with STRICT_DEDUP=1

Current finding from guardrail:
- 3 hard duplicate signatures still present across retake sets (2 in practice-6, 1 in practice-7)
- examples: rp6-q3 vs rp5-q1, rp6-q7 vs rp1-q6, rp7-q2 vs rp1-q2

Request:
- GR/GA: decide whether to rotate these values now or accept as soft duplicates.
- If accepted, we can keep advisory mode. If not, switch STRICT_DEDUP=1 in CI gate.
